ten_goi.chu: In English, it is named after the ancient Roman god Mercurius (Mercury), god of commerce and communication, and the messenger of the gods.

moc.chu: After giving birth to the baby, Maia wrapped him in blankets and went to sleep.
In Homeric Hymn 4 to Hermes describes the god's birth and his theft of Apollo's sacred cattle.
He is said to have invented the chelys lyre, as well as racing and the sport of wrestling.
Maia refused to believe Apollo when he claimed that Hermes was the thief, and Zeus then sided with Apollo.
Finally, Apollo exchanged the cattle for the lyre, which became one of his identifying attributes.
